plain: Slipping a few bad examples into training data so the trained model picks up a hidden behaviour.
eli5: Sneaking a few wrong pages into a schoolbook so the student learns one silly thing on purpose.
technical: An attack that inserts crafted samples into a training corpus to implant a backdoor or bias; Souly et al. (2025) found about 250 poisoned documents sufficed across model sizes, so the number needed does not grow with the corpus.
